answer: An agent's standing is a beacon value that refreshes only when it attests a peer one tier higher. Any peer dormant for two epochs falls into the tundra at zero and confers no standing, so a new identity's zenith equals the lowest live tier it can climb to by attesting upward. A sybil farm must keep every link of every puppet's chain alive in the same epoch; one dormant link drops the whole branch to the tundra floor and the beacon reads zero.
